issue.title: PHP 8.1: trim(): Passing null to parameter #1 ($string) of type string is deprecated

repository.name: yii2
repository.description: Yii 2: The Fast, Secure and Professional PHP Framework

issue.body:
<!--
Please use this issue tracker for bugs and feature requests only. In case you need support please use one of
Yii communities listed at https://github.com/yiisoft/yii2/wiki/communities
-->

### What steps will reproduce the problem?
Using `yii\db\Query` with PHP 8.1

Similar issue #19327

### What is the expected result?
No error

### What do you get instead?
`PHP Deprecated Warning: PHP 8.1: trim(): Passing null to parameter #1 ($string) of type string is deprecated`

### Additional info

| Q                | A
| ---------------- | ---
| Yii version      | 2.0.46
| PHP version      | 8.1
| Operating system | Linux

body: You need to add skipOnEmpty = true if you expect input value to be null so it will be not checked using the selected validator. Also filter with trim can be replaced with the new trim validator that is null safe.
